name: colonies-06-daughter-machine
title: Daughter machine (viva-munk) — device run + phenotype distributions
description:
Run the canonical viva-munk DAUGHTER MACHINE — a single cell in a chamber
with an absorbing right wall, so the lineage grows leftward as daughters are
pushed out — populated by viva-munk's simple grow/divide agents. The
simulation runs now and produces (a) an animated GIF of the device running and
(b) distribution figures for the core single-cell phenotypes: size at
division, time between birth and division, and added size before division (the
adder plot).

Simulations run now; biological conclusions are HELD for experimental data (a
planned comparison study, colonies-09). This study establishes the measurement
+ visualization pipeline against cheap agents.

baseline.name: daughter-machine-simple
baseline.note:
Nominal composite for the workbench catalog. The actual run drives the
viva-munk daughter_machine_document (via v2ecoli.colony_bench.devices) with
simple grow/divide agents — the canonical device geometry, not the free
colony. Phenotypes are extracted uniformly by colony_bench.phenotypes.

pipeline_gate.proceed_condition:
Requires the shared cell-tier factory, geometry builders, and phenotype
extractor stood up in colonies-04.
